candidate.definition_en: A person who is not in the armed services or the police force.
candidate.explanation_ar: الشخص المدني اللي مش عسكري ولا ظابط شرطة.

senses.definition_en: A person who is not in the armed services or the police force.
senses.definition_ar: شخص مدني ليس فرداً في الجيش أو الشرطة.
examples: He is not a soldier, he is a civilian.
As a civilian, she had never received any military training.
Under international law, an unarmed civilian must not be targeted during wartime.
He is not a soldier, he is a civilian.
As a civilian, she had never received any military training.
Under international law, an unarmed civilian must not be targeted during wartime.
candidate.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الصفة.. 'Civil' مدني، فالـ 'Civilian' هو المواطن المدني.
